Item 2 attributes "Axis Capital" but the WebFetch receipt for that specific NewKerala URL didn't confirm the source name. Fixing only that attribution:

[{"claim": "Axis Capital estimates India's installed data-centre capacity at 1.3–1.4 GW and projects a realistic 3–3.6 GW by 2030, calling industry targets of 6–8 GW aggressive.", "url": "https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/2030-forecast/indias-data-centre-capacity-may-reach-3-3-6-gw-by-2030-hyperscalers-to-drive-growth-axis-capital", "date": "2026-08-02", "quote_fragment": "Publicly announced capacity targets of 6-8 GW by 2030 appear aggressive."},{"claim": "India's AI-enabled data-centre infrastructure costs 10–15% more per MW than traditional colocation, with hyperscalers projected to account for 90% of Indian demand by 2030 versus 60% currently.", "url": "https://www.newkerala.com/news/a/indias-data-centre-capacity-may-reach-3-36-gw-994.htm", "date": "2026-08-02", "quote_fragment": "Hyperscalers could account for around 90 per cent of data centre demand by 2030, compared with the current 60 per cent share."},{"claim": "Axis Capital warns that execution bottlenecks and supply-chain constraints may limit India's operational data-centre capacity to around 2.8 GW by 2030, with current installed capacity at approximately 1.4 GW.", "url": "https://www.newkerala.com/news/a/supply-chain-constraints-may-cap-indias-data-centre-capacity-773.htm", "date": "2026-08-03", "quote_fragment": "Execution bottlenecks and supply-chain constraints could significantly slow India's data centre capacity expansion"}]
